reviewed_substitutions.after: Thomas was born on 1 May 1777 and baptised on 7 May in Rathdowney Catholic parish, Queen’s County (now Laois), Ireland, the son of [[Glasgow-3593|David Glascow]] and [[Ford-28175|Anne Ford]].<ref name="Rathdowney1777">Rathdowney Catholic parish register, NLI microfilm 05013/08, image 83, manuscript p.147, Thomas entry near the foot of the right-hand page; [https://registers.nli.ie/pages/vtls000631901_083 National Library of Ireland original scan], inspected 22 October 2026. Born 1 May; baptised 7 May 1777; parents David Glascow and Anne Ford. Household place and sponsors remain unread.</ref>
reviewed_substitutions.basis: Original p.147 separates birth and baptism dates and expressly names both parents.
